meta.wetgeving.html.title: Legislation and energy regulation for hotels · Lemnion
meta.wetgeving.html.description: Which energy and building regulation applies to your hotel? The BACS obligation, the EPBD directive and more. We list the rules that matter for your hotel.
wetgeving.sub: Energy and building regulation for hotels is changing fast. From the BACS obligation to the European EPBD directive on the energy performance of buildings. We list the rules that matter for your hotel and explain what they mean for you.
wetgeving.label: Regulation at a glance
wetgeving.lead: Dutch and European rules keep raising the bar for the energy performance of buildings. For each topic we explain what applies, to whom, and when it takes effect.
wetgeving.c1p: Since 1 January 2026, non-residential buildings with a heating or air-conditioning system above 290 kW must have a building automation and control system. Check whether your hotel falls within scope and what is needed.
wetgeving.c2p: The European Energy Performance of Buildings Directive (EPBD) brings, among other things, an obligation for EV charging infrastructure at existing car parks and stricter energy performance requirements. Read the page about EPBD IV and charging infrastructure to find out what it means for hotels.
wetgeving.c3p: From 2027 the net-metering arrangement for surplus solar power will be phased out. What that means for your hotel depends on your energy contract and your own generation. Our explanation sets it out.
wetgeving.c4p: Legislation is accelerating electric driving, including the rules on leasing and taxable benefit. For your hotel this can be an opportunity to make your fleet and charging infrastructure more sustainable.
wetgeving.c5p: On top of the energy performance requirements, there are periodic inspections for your electrical installations, boilers, solar panels and charging infrastructure. Find out which scopes apply to you and how often an inspection is needed.
wetgeving.c6p: Sites with high energy use must take recognised measures and report on them every 4 years. Check whether your hotel is in scope and what you need to do.
wetgeving.ctah: Want to know which rules apply to your hotel?
wetgeving.ctap: In a short conversation we map out your situation and explain which obligations apply to your hotel. No strings attached.
